summary: Implemented Phase 1 `GaussianPulse` and `ContinuousWave` source-time profiles with immutable public models, typed IR lowering, and representative waveform tests.
key_findings: `src/autofdtd/sources/time.py` now defines `SourceTime` and `Pulse` bases plus concrete `GaussianPulse` and `ContinuousWave` models with finite parameter validation, analytic `amp_time()` evaluation, `frequency_range()`, and explicit `end_time()` behavior.

`src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` now adds typed `GaussianPulseIR` and `ContinuousWaveIR` models plus `source_time_to_ir()`, and generic source envelopes lower nested `source_time` payloads into typed IR dicts.
Public exports were wired through `autofdtd.sources`, `autofdtd.api`, and the package root so later source families can reuse the same tagged source-time surface.
Verification passed with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q` (134 passed) and `PYTHONPATH=src python -m compileall src/autofdtd tests`.
`ruff` and `mypy` were not installed in the current environment, so lint/type-check verification could not be run.
